thread:
anya: Quick heads-up: competitor SkyRoute announced per-tenant routing + billing tiers this morning. Several pilots asked if we can offer "route profiles" so they can lower cost on non-critical paths. Need a short sync on scope and risks.

sam: Saw it. SkyRoute's offering ties UI routing rules to their billing pipeline. That level of integration is heavy. We should consider a 'profiles first' approach to decouple billing.

maria: Pilots really want an easy knob to reduce spend for bulk inference (batching / async routes). They told Sales they'll consider switching if we don't provide even a stopgap. :worried:

felix: I'm wary of a shallow parity response that creates maintenance debt. Our quantization & KV-prefetch work yields better long-term unit cost wins for everyone. But I can see why customers ask for per-route controls.

lee: Proposal: deliver route profiles (metadata + mapping) that let customers define "high-cost/high-quality", "balanced", "low-cost" per route. Implementation plan: lightweight API + console for tagging, a rules engine that maps route metadata to model_variant, and telemetry to show expected cost delta. Billing integration deferred to Q2.

sam: Yes. Minimal API contract sketch to unblock pilots:

```json
{
  "route_id": "cart-embeddings",
  "profile_policy": [
    {"when": "payload_size>1000", "map": "low_cost_variant"},
    {"when": "priority==true", "map": "hq_variant"}
  ]
}
```

maria: Pilots want per-route SLA opt-outs too (e.g., "no latency SLO for background indexing"). For MVP we can surface a soft opt-out toggle and document implications.

devrel-bot: Deploy notes: reuse feature_flag infra for gradual exposure. Add canary to 5% of tenants.

anya: Risk list: 1) Unexpected cache/kv behavior when mapping to smaller models 2) Confusion if console shows cost estimates that differ from billed amounts (billing integration lag) 3) Routing rules complexity. Mitigations: cache regression tests, explicit warning in console about billing phase, and a preserved default route policy (safe fallback).

felix: Add two tech cookies: (A) ensure KV cache keys include model_variant tag so cache is not polluted; (B) measure tail latency when switching variants under load.

sam: Rough prioritization: Sprint 1 (API + minimal rules engine + feature flags), Sprint 2 (console + telemetry + soft opt-out), Sprint 3 (billing reporting + quotas). Estimate: 2, 3, 4 sprints.

maria: I'll brief Sales + pilots with the phased plan and gather acceptance criteria for the soft opt-out.

anya: Action items: Sam -> internal PRD and API contract by Thu; Felix -> cache spike and regression tests by Tue; Lee -> console mockups and UX copy by end of week; Maria -> pilot acceptance criteria and comms. Revisit next Wed. :thumbsup:

anya: Short thread. Thanks everyone.
